rules.statement: A partition under the repealed Partition Ordinance of a paraveni panguwa is not valid even where the ninda proprietor is a consenting party to the proceedings. In such a case, the partition decree is a nullity.
rules.supporting_quote: 'The question that arises for decision on this appeal is whether the partition under the repealed Partition Ordinance of a paraveni land is valid in a case where the proprietor of a nindagama or viharagama is also a consenting party to the proceedings. It has been held in the case of Appuhamy et al. v. Menike et al., 1[1 (1917) 19 N. L. R. 361.] by a Bench of three Judges of this Court, that a paraveni panguhama cannot be the subject of a partition action under the repealed Partition Ordinance.'
